Senorita Amanita
My friend and I went searching the town for anybody with Salvia in their flower gardens when we stumbled upon a happy little grove of amanitas. We picked the ones that had the yellowish reddish color to them and did the research to see if they were legit, which they were.
Well we decided the best course of action would be to make tea from skins of one large cap and 2 small.  We brought approx. 1.5 liters to a boil added the shrooms and boiled em for about 20-25 mins.  We divided the tea between the two of us and chugged away.  We walked around town a bit and came back.
It was about an hour max.
The feelings:
Lightness..(made for real fun walking)
Static vision.. self explanatory
calm and relaxed feeling
sorta zoned out, dumb feeling, but kinda cool...haha
drunk feeling with warmness
also, we didn't feel like talking much
